title: New agent
override_hint: Only for this new agent; next time it goes back to the default.
default_hint: Uses the new-agent default from the shared model settings.
models_failed: Couldn't load the model list. You can still start with the default model.
effort_unsupported_default: The default model doesn't support thinking effort.
prompt_placeholder_keys: What should it do… ({keys} to start)
attach_hint: Paste or drop images and files · sent in the background after start
permission_mode_hint: You can change the mode in the conversation later; Allow all can only be picked when starting.
no_computer_body: An agent runs on one of your computers, so there is nothing to pick here yet. Add one first.
worktree_hint: A branch and a checkout of its own: the agent changes code there, and this folder stays as it is.
blocked_terminal_body: Persona found “{name}” in this computer's login shell, but the shell new terminal tabs run doesn't have it: another shell, a container, or a startup file that stops early. New agents start in those tabs.
blocked_terminal_fix_rc: Define it in a startup file the terminal's shell reads (for bash, ~/.bashrc), then start again.
blocked_terminal_fix_provider: Or add it to Persona as a model provider: those work in any terminal.
blocked_terminal_clears: A start with it that works clears this; otherwise it clears by itself after 6 hours.
blocked_other_body: Its latest check on this computer failed, and automatic repair didn't fix it.
blocked_other_fix: Fix its key, gateway or CLI on that computer, or pick another launcher.
blocked_other_clears: A check or start with it that works clears this.
preset_hint: From {profile}: fills in launcher, model and effort, which you can still change.
preset_left_out: Not applied here: {what}. The launcher's or model's own setting runs.
